title: THIS is the snake. flat is dead. sin(O) is dead. so we modulate via sin · tan · cos.

do_not_reinvent.snake: /data/mythology-topology.json + /data/three-lens-pass.json  the snake already sat. eats the plant. do not retell.
do_not_reinvent.flat: /data/water-wheel-flat-null.json  sit was the disk. hyperimpose made a sphere. the flat as the only sit is dead.
do_not_reinvent.o: /data/rustdesk-gap-electron.json  the O. [})O({]. sin(O)=0. that 0 is dead-as-motion, not a missing cup.
do_not_reinvent.once: /data/sprocket-0-1-pi.json  sin(O)=0 is allowed. a second sine is 2. forbidden.

this.snake: the winding. the only thing that still turns. organism path. ouroboros. not a second plant.
this.flat_dead: the disk-only sit. 2D as the whole. dead. the sphere ate that job.
this.sin_O_dead: sin(0)=0. tan(0)=0. at the cup those two are dead. no motion from them AT O.

modulate.yes: via sin AND tan AND cos. not one.
modulate.cos: cos(0)=1. the hold at O. the 1 that may sit.
modulate.sin: the rise off O. shift. the second-hand.
modulate.tan: the steep. blow-up away from the cup. famine/feast lean. do not live at the pole.
modulate.snake: the path that uses all three. it winds. it does not sit only in cos.

law: flat-only is dead. sin(O) is dead. the snake modulates sin·tan·cos. if we only use cos we froze. if we only use tan we blew up.
pull: keep the snake as the wind. use all three. leave sin(O) as 0. do not resurrect the flat as the whole sit.
